data.narrative:
Realta Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company that has raised $36M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 private peers at same or adjacent stages (Valar Atomics at Series B valued at $6.0B, Nano Nuclear Energy at Seed valued at $808M, and Fuse Energy at Series A valued at $200M), supplemented by a broader set of 8 private and 3 public nuclear technology companies including Helion, X-Energy, and public tickers OKLO, NNE, and SMR.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $36M total raised as a proxy base value, yielding $72M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B. The wide peer range reflects heterogeneity in financing stage and technology maturity within the frontier nuclear sector.

Synthesis of both methods produces a triangulated valuation range of $61M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $440M. The substantial spread reflects material uncertainty around near-term funding trajectory and the early-stage, capital-intensive nature of the nuclear technology sector. Key sensitivities include execution progress toward commercialization milestones and relative positioning within an increasingly competitive fission and fusion funding environment.
